description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the EmployeeLicenseAPI class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests various API endpoints related to employee license management, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of employee license records, as well as validation rules for these operations.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseAPITest
classes.description: This is a PHPUnit test class that tests the EmployeeLicenseAPI endpoints for managing employee licenses within the OrangeHRM system. It verifies correct behavior and validation for CRUD operations and data retrieval.
